items.summary: Fishing Lake First Nation is an Anishnabe Nation in the Treaty 4 territory. The Saulteaux Peoples are a branch of the Ojibway Nations (Nahkawininwak). Saulteaux comes from the French word saulteurs or "people of the rapids." This refers to their original territories around Sault Saint Marie where French fur traders and the Ojibway met to trade in the late 17th century. ​
